title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2607.23116v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time-dependent routing recognizes that the same journey can take a different time depending on when it begins. Under duration minimization, even the departure time of each vehicle becomes a decision. Exact methods for this setting exist in the literature, but researchers and practitioners have lacked a ready-to-use open solver that combines rich piecewise-linear travel times, early feasible solutions and optimality claims. KAYROS fills this gap with two modes on one checker-consistent engine: an Iterated Local Search that streams improving solutions and a Branch-Price-and-Cut method that can issue computational optimality certificates under explicit arithmetic and search assumptions. It installs with one command and has no proprietary dependency. translated_title: KAYROS：一个面向时长最小化时间依赖型车辆路径问题的随时可中断且精确的开源求解器——一份技术报告与一个人机工程案例研究
translated_abstract: 时间依赖型路径规划认识到，同一段行程所需的时间会因其开始时刻的不同而变化。在时长最小化的目标下，甚至每辆车的出发时间本身也成为一项决策。文献中虽然已有针对该问题的精确方法，但研究人员和从业者一直缺乏一个开箱即用的开源求解器，能够同时提供丰富的分段线性行程时间函数、早期可行解以及最优性证明。KAYROS 填补了这一空白：它在同一个与验证器保持一致的引擎上提供两种模式——一种是可持续输出改进解的迭代局部搜索，另一种是可在明确的算术与搜索假设下给出计算最优性证书的分支定价与割平面方法。它仅需一条命令即可安装，且不依赖任何专有软件。公开的 MAMUT-routing 存储库目前包含 704 份基于“四次求解发布协议”的 KAYROS 证书，该协议还促成了对早前无效声明的撤回与修正。
tldr: KAYROS 是一个开源、随时可中断且能给出最优性证书的时长最小化时间依赖型车辆路径求解器，填补了该领域缺乏可直接使用的精确求解工具的空白。
en_tdlr: KAYROS is an open-source, anytime and exact solver for duration-minimization time-dependent vehicle routing, filling the gap of a ready-to-use tool that provides early feasible solutions and computational optimality certificates.
